name: agentic-engineering
description: A dozen plugins list about eighty skills, and a job does not say which one it needs, so this is one plugin: a person types /agentic-engineering:start-here and is asked what they want; an agent calls one of eight areas by name (agents, code, delivery, design, docs, harness, planning, writing); and each area routes to its own procedures, read as documents that cost nothing until one is taken.

syncIntervalSeconds.title: Remote sync interval
syncIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between runs of `aw board remote sync` while the /kanban pane is open on a board with remote sync on (30 at least).
